description: A clear plastic sports drink bottle with an orange cap sits on a green bedsheet in front of a large dark pillow. The left hand reaches forward to grasp the bottle and hold it steady as a left-hand object, while the right hand comes down onto the cap and twists it to unscrew, briefly making the bottle a two-hand object; then the right hand lifts the loosened cap away and sets it down to the right, leaving the left hand still holding the open bottle.
